strings.site.tagline: Watch real hands play your music. Then drag it into your DAW.
strings.site.description: Freally Handscore writes chords, a melody, a bassline and a countermelody in the style of any genre, artist or producer, shows them as four sheets of music, and plays them on a realistic piano with realistic hands. A CLAP, VST3 and AU plugin and standalone app for Windows, macOS and Linux — offline and 100% AI-free.
